order_raw:
1. Complete musculoskeletal and neurological examination, including joint inspection and palpation, range-of-motion testing, manual muscle testing, gait assessment, and reflexes
2. Complete blood count
3. Comprehensive metabolic panel
4. Creatine kinase
5. Erythrocyte sedimentation rate
6. C-reactive protein
7. Thyroid-stimulating hormone
8. Serum vitamin B12
9. Serum ferritin and iron studies
10. Plain radiographs of the symptomatic joint or region
11. Electromyography and nerve-conduction studies
12. Magnetic resonance imaging of the symptomatic region
dx: Undifferentiated musculoskeletal pain or weakness, etiology undetermined
